topic: How Sun, Moon, and Stars Influence Human Activities
key_concepts: Sunlight makes outdoor activities like picnics and swimming enjoyable
Plants grow better when they get enough sunlight
Daylight helps people see better and makes walking and crossing streets safer
The Moon causes tides, which people use to generate electricity
Ships come closer to shore when the Moon makes the water deeper
Fishermen use bright lights to attract fish during a new moon
Some celebrations are timed by moon phases, such as Chinese New Year, Eid al-Fitr, and Eas
The North Star helps people find their way
Star patterns are used for storytelling and guiding fishermen at sea
Three stars in a row signal the coming cold season
